# Route mode has no Model: state is the per-request State struct. A function the
# program declared inside a component therefore has nowhere else to live, and
# the call site used to render `m.keep(x)` -- a receiver this file has no
# binding for, calling a function it never wrote. Neither compiled.
#
# They are emitted as methods on the route's State, so they dispatch through
# the same `s` the state fields do.
#
# `__inst0` is the instantiation suffix, and it is the whole of what `main()`
# at the root of the file costs: `main` is an ordinary component now, so the
# inliner splices it into the package body and renames what it declares per
# instantiation. The receiver goes with the declaration -- a component-body
# func is a method and a package-level one is not -- which is what keeps the
# helper in routeEmittableFuncs, whose filter drops anything still carrying
# one.

sngl generate --lang go --platform html -o out app.sngl

# The function is there, as a State method, under the name the call uses.
grep 'State\) Keep__inst0\(n int\) bool' out/server.go
grep 's\.Keep__inst0\(' out/server.go

# One that reads state works for the same reason: the receiver carries it.
grep 'State\) Biggest__inst0\(\) int' out/server.go
grep 's\.Biggest__inst0\(\)' out/server.go

# And nothing dispatches through a Model that route mode does not have.
! grep 'm\.' out/server.go

# And it compiles. A grep over generated Go cannot say that, which is how an
# unbound route parameter survived in this file's own output.
exec go build ./...

-- go.mod --
module routefuncs

go 1.24

-- srv/srv.go --
package srv

func Bump(n int) int { return n + 1 }

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "go:routefuncs/srv"
import "sngl:platform/html"

component main root {
    var nums list<int> = [1, 2, 3]
    var total = 0

    func keep(n int) bool { return n > 1 }
    func biggest() int { return nums.length() + total }

    window #home(title="t") {
        html.button(innerText="go", @click {
            total = srv.Bump(nums.filter(keep).length() + biggest())
        })
        html.span(innerText=string(total))
    }
}

main()
